# Philosophy Research & Thought Sharing Archive
> Digital garden and research platform dedicated to Epistemology, Symbolic Logic, Ethics, Metaphysics, and Philosophy of Mind by funtohard.

## Main Sections
- [/research](https://funtohard.github.io/research): Peer-reviewed style long-form research papers with formal proofs, citations, and analytical frameworks.
- [/thoughts](https://funtohard.github.io/thoughts): Short-form philosophical reflections, essays, micro-thoughts, and conceptual observations.
- [/topics](https://funtohard.github.io/topics): Topic taxonomy including Epistemology, Logic, Ethics, Philosophy, Metaphysics, and Mind.

## Key Research Topics
1. **Epistemological Limits & Semantics**: The paradox of definition, semantic observer effects, and natural language syntax normalization.
2. **Philosophy of Computation & Systems Programming**: Formal abstract virtual machines, compiler semantic contracts, and Undefined Behavior.
3. **Ethics & Intellectual History**: Epistemic injustice, collaborative authorship, and historical erasure in philosophical partnerships.
